deadline.value: Applications can be submitted at any time; the MIN Faculty sets no application deadline.
deadline.quote: Applications for admission to doctoral procedures can be submitted at any time; there is no application deadline.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

funding.value: Funding is not guaranteed: job contracts exist only when a supervisor has one, and scholarships such as the MIN short-term stipend or a merit scholarship must be applied for.
funding.quote: international doctoral researchers can apply for a short-term stipend of the MIN graduate school or a merit scholarship of the International Dept for a twelve-month period

also.quote: Doctoral supervisors can only award job contracts if they are available.

entry_route.value: Admission normally needs a completed degree in a relevant subject; a bachelor's graduate can apply only through the Fast Track programme.
entry_route.quote: The key prerequisite is a completed university degree in a subject relevant to the doctoral dissertation project

also.quote: Fast Track: Under certain conditions, admission to the fast track program can be granted after a successful excellent Bachelor's degree in a relevant degree program.

toefl_min.value: The MIN Faculty requires no English test, so no TOEFL score is needed for admission.
toefl_min.quote: A language test or proof of language proficiency is not required for admission to doctoral procedures.

ielts_min.value: The MIN Faculty requires no English test, so no IELTS score is needed for admission.
ielts_min.quote: A language test or proof of language proficiency is not required for admission to doctoral procedures.

english_waiver.value: No English test is needed for MIN doctoral admission, so an English-medium degree from India needs no waiver.
english_waiver.quote: A language test or proof of language proficiency is not required for admission to doctoral procedures.

supervisor.value: You must find a supervisor in the department before you can apply for admission.
supervisor.quote: Before you can apply for official admission to the doctoral procedures you need to find a supervisor from our department.

notes: The Informatics FAQ recommends applying within the first six months and not later than nine months after starting research work; that is a recommendation, not a deadline.
